nodes.text: India has confirmed its first cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in 2025, with two infants in Bengaluru being diagnosed. An eight-month-old boy and a three-month-old girl tested positive for HMPV, both having a history of bronchopneumonia. These cases were identified through https://t.co/C4TlY4fSqD
